q.description: A question card whose answer stays hidden behind a collapsed "Answer" region, with an optional difficulty level and topic tag.

attributes.name: q
attributes.description: The question, shown in the card header above the collapsed answer.

attributes.name: level
attributes.description: The difficulty tag. An unrecognized value shows as written, styled neutral.

attributes.name: topic
attributes.description: A small neutral tag next to the level.

topic.description: A topic header row with a one-to-five confidence rating drawn as filled and empty dots.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The topic, for when bracket content is not used.

attributes.name: confidence
attributes.description: A confidence rating from 1 to 5, drawn as filled and empty dots.

quiz.description: The questions a note already contains, collected by a script into one worked-through list with each answer behind a click-to-reveal region.

attributes.name: data
attributes.description: The bound quiz: an object with a questions array of {q, topic, level, answer}.

pitfall.description: A common-mistake callout with its own marker and accent, separate from the standard callout styling.
